description: This Java source file defines the CallSimpleMethod class, which implements the <call-simple-method> element in a mini-language framework. It handles invoking simple methods defined in external XML resources, managing execution scope, and mapping results to fields.

classes.name: CallSimpleMethod
classes.description: Implements the <call-simple-method> element, managing invocation of simple methods, handling scope, and result mapping.

classes.name: CallSimpleMethod.ResultToField
classes.description: Handles mapping of method results to environment fields based on configuration.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the call-simple-method operation, invoking the specified simple method, handling errors, and mapping results.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information related to the called simple method.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method to call.

methods.name: getXmlResource
methods.description: Returns the XML resource location of the simple method definition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the call-simple-method element.
